next: Next episode — **server** mode = your server list (`/airings`); **global** mode = all releases.
planning: Weekly schedule — **server** mode = server list; **global** = all releases.
decouverte: Random anime (AniList) — **slash** replies are **ephemeral**; Again / Track buttons.
monnext: Your next episode (linked AniList account required).
animequiz: Solo quiz: guess the anime from the image (difficulty choice) — XP and quiz score.
animequizmulti: Chain **5–20** solo quizzes in a row (mixed difficulties) — XP and combos.
guessop: Guess the opening (audio) — blind test on real themes.
guessopchain: Chain several Guess OP rounds with streak bonus and score recap.
guessyear: Guess the air year (image + answer in channel).
guessepisodes: Guess the episode count (image + answer in channel).
guessgenre: Guess one of the genres (image + text answer).
guesswho: Guess the character on a blurred image — Easy / Normal / Hard (blur + XP).
chainquiz: Chain solo quizzes: difficulty rises with each correct answer.
raid_statut: Channel, schedule, auto or not, next slot (bot timezone).
raidconfig: Admins: interactive panel (channel, auto ON/OFF, day, hour, minutes, precise HH:MM).
raidstart: Start a raid boss (admin): confirmation + max 1× per week / server.
raidalerttest: Send a test “raid in 1 h” style message (admin).
minijeux: Two menus: **Guessing games** and **Other** — pick to start a game (duel → `/duel @member`).
linkanilist: Step 1: link AniList with a code in your bio, then `/verifyanilist`.
verifyanilist: Step 2: confirm the link after pasting the code in About on AniList.
streak: Show your daily streak and record.
mission: Today’s mission: claim XP or reroll (1/week).
showmission: Mission catalogue by **category** (dropdown) + your stats (ephemeral in slash). Alias: `missionsliste`.
mycard: Panoramic image (level, XP, AniList, favourite, minigames) — no embed; details: **`/profile`**.
profile: Detailed profile: XP, streak, minigame counters, Guess genre penalties, trophy preview.
animefav: Set your favourite anime (title, ID or AniList URL) — shown on **`/mycard`**.
reportbug: Report an issue in **DMs** (bug, translation, typo); **XP** if confirmed — counter on **`/mycard`**.
mystats: AniList stats (watched, days, mean score, favourite genre).
mybadges: Trophies by category (Initiate → Myth tiers) and progress bars.
duelstats: AniList engagement duel: completed, airing, episodes, time (+ rating if both rate).
quiztop: Quiz leaderboard + last month’s podium and rewards.
animetop: Minigame leaderboard with dropdown (total, preview or one game) — podium + table; names via Discord if off-server.
quizlevels: Quiz tiers (monthly score) and XP ranks: **one menu** to choose what to show.
stats: AniList stats for a specified user.
add: Add an anime to your watchlist.
remove: Remove an anime from your watchlist.
setchannel: Channel for episode release cards (/airings list). Independent from raid channel (`/raidconfig`).
setlevelupchannel: Channel for announcements: new global title (XP) and new quiz title (else: channel where play happened).
guide_admin: (DM, admins) Server setup: airings, setchannel, XP levels, raid.
vote: ⭐ Support the bot on Top.gg: link, bonus XP, cooldown; DM reminder (buttons).
recap: DM recap “Releases today” (linked AniList). Buttons + HH:MM input; precision with `/setalert`.
setalert: HH:MM time for DM recap (bot timezone). Complements `/recap` for a precise time (e.g. 08:30).
source: Link to the bot’s GitHub repo.
uptime: How long the bot has been running.
airings: Server list: pick anime tracked for /next and /planning (admin).
all: Browse AniList releases and fill the server list (admin).
guide: (DM) Player tutorial: XP, minigames, AniList — not server setup (see `/guide_admin`).
owner: Owner panel: debug, sync, stats, tests, Guess OP, raid test — dropdown.
